description: Phonon calculation via finite differences or DFPT

IBRION.note: finite differences with symmetry (5 without symmetry)

EDIFF.note: very tight, critical for phonon accuracy

POTIM.note: displacement in Angstrom for finite differences

LEPSILON.note: for Born effective charges and dielectric tensor

LCALCEPS.note: alternative to LEPSILON using finite field

method_finite_diff.note: Use supercell large enough that interactions decay within it. Typically 2x2x2 or larger.

method_dfpt.note: DFPT only at Gamma. For dispersion: use supercell method or PHON_DISPERSION.

phonon_dispersion.description: Full phonon dispersion using finite differences + Fourier interpolation
workflow: 4. Post-process with phonopy or VASP built-in (PHON_DISPERSION)

kpoints.rule: Dense Gamma-centered mesh. Converge carefully for phonons.
kpoints.note: Supercell method needs fewer k-points (Gamma-only may suffice for large supercells)
